narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='m1'/>Six goes into twenty four and into thirty six, so I will cut six metre pieces.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>Six does divide both ribbons, but we asked for the greatest length.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>A longer equal piece may still fit, so six may not be the greatest.

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>Equal pieces use a common factor, and the greatest piece uses the highest common factor.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>Then divide each ribbon by the piece length and add the pieces.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>Your turn. Two ribbons are forty metres and fifty six metres. Find the longest equal piece and the number of pieces.
